# Sentinel Design System

> React + Tailwind v4 component library and design tokens for cybersecurity products (threat dashboards, scans, assets, findings, severity). Version 1.3.1. 36 copy-paste components (shadcn-style: you own the code), themed with `snt-*` CSS variables in light and dark mode, targeting WCAG 2.2 AA and the WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices (remaining gaps are listed per component).

## Rules for AI agents

1. **Use the existing components.** Install them with the shadcn CLI (`npx shadcn add @sentinel/<name>`, see Setup) — or copy `/components/<slug>.tsx.txt` into `components/ui/<slug>.tsx`. Don't recreate a component that already exists, and don't restyle it from scratch. Check props and defaults in [sentinel-manifest.json](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/sentinel-manifest.json).
2. **Never hard-code colours, font sizes, shadows or z-indexes.** Use the `snt-*` tokens through Tailwind utilities (`bg-snt-surface-app`, `text-snt-text-secondary`, `border-snt-border-default`, `shadow-snt-lg`, `z-modal`). Font sizes use the type scale `text-snt-{10,11,12,14,16,18,20,24,32,48}` (numbers are px). Every token is defined in `theme.css`.
3. **Prefer semantic tokens over scale primitives.** Borders: `border-snt-border-default` / `-strong` / `-focus` / `-error`. Tints: `bg-snt-bg-subtle`, `bg-snt-bg-{brand,info,success,warning,error}-subtle`. Focus: `ring-snt-focus-ring` (`-error` for destructive). Text: `text-snt-text-*`. Surfaces: `bg-snt-surface-*`. Use `snt-scale-<hue>-<step>` / `snt-neutral-*` primitives only when the hue itself is the meaning (severity, data series). Use `text-snt-text-disabled` only for disabled controls; it fails contrast for normal text.
4. **Follow each component's "When to use / When not to use".** For example, a destructive confirm is a `Modal` with `Button intent="destructive"`, a vulnerability level is always `SeverityBadge`, and navigation is a link, not a `Button`.
5. **Accessibility is part of the API.** Pass `label` to form fields, `aria-label` to icon-only buttons and to `RadioGroup` / `TabsList`, and an `aria-label` with the takeaway to charts. Don't remove the focus styles.
6. **Respect the status.** `deprecated` components (Banner) must not be used in new code; follow the migration note. `alpha` components may change.
7. **Check "Known gaps"** in each doc before assuming a behaviour exists.
8. **Naming:** states are lowercase (`state="error"`), colour families are `tone` (not `color`).
9. **Lint your output.** Add [eslint-plugin-sentinel](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/eslint-plugin-sentinel.mjs) (`sentinel.configs.recommended`): it rejects hard-coded colours and unlabeled icon-only buttons, and autofixes primitives to semantic tokens. Fix every error before finishing.

## Setup

- **Requirements:** React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, `clsx`, `tailwind-merge` and `lucide-react`. `Tabs` has no extra deps; `Modal` uses `react-dom`'s `createPortal`.
- **Install with the shadcn CLI:** add `"registries": { "@sentinel": "https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/r/{name}.json" }` to `components.json`, then `npx shadcn add @sentinel/theme` once and `npx shadcn add @sentinel/<name>` per component. The same config lets the shadcn MCP server (`npx shadcn mcp init`) list and search Sentinel components for your agent.
- **Project rules file:** copy [AGENTS.template.md](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/AGENTS.template.md) to your repo root as `AGENTS.md`.
- **Lint guardrails:** save [eslint-plugin-sentinel.mjs](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/eslint-plugin-sentinel.mjs) in your repo and add `import sentinel from "./eslint-plugin-sentinel.mjs"` + `sentinel.configs.recommended` to `eslint.config.mjs` (flat config).
- **Tokens and theme:** add [theme.css](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/theme.css) after `@import "tailwindcss";`. Dark mode is enabled with `.dark` or `[data-snt-theme="dark"]` on an ancestor.
- **`cn()` helper** at `@/lib/utils`:

```ts
import { clsx, type ClassValue } from "clsx"
import { extendTailwindMerge } from "tailwind-merge"

// tailwind-merge treats unknown `text-*` classes as colours, so without this it
// would drop the Sentinel type scale (`text-snt-14`) whenever a colour like
// `text-snt-text-secondary` follows it.
const twMerge = extendTailwindMerge({
  extend: {
    classGroups: {
      "font-size": [{ text: [(value: string) => /^snt-\d+$/.test(value)] }],
    },
  },
})

export function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) {
  return twMerge(clsx(inputs))
}

/**
 * Portalled UI (Modal, Drawer, Menu, Select list, Toasts) is mounted on <body>,
 * outside the app's `.dark` / `[data-snt-theme]` wrapper, so it would always
 * render light. Call this with the element it belongs to (the trigger, or the
 * previously focused element) to copy the nearest theme onto the portalled node.
 */
export function inheritTheme(source: Element | null | undefined, target: HTMLElement | null | undefined) {
  if (!target) return
  const themed = source?.closest<HTMLElement>(".dark, [data-snt-theme]")
  const dark = !!themed && (themed.classList.contains("dark") || themed.dataset.sntTheme === "dark")
  target.classList.toggle("dark", dark)
  if (dark) target.dataset.sntTheme = "dark"
  else delete target.dataset.sntTheme
}
```

## Atoms

- [Activity Timeline](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/activity-timeline.md) **[beta]**: A time-ordered list of events: an attack timeline, an audit log, or the history of a finding. Source: [activity-timeline.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/activity-timeline.tsx.txt)
- [Alert](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/alert.md) **[beta]**: An inline message tied to a page or section. It communicates a status that persists until the condition changes or the user dismisses it. Source: [alert.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/alert.tsx.txt)
- [Badge · Tag](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/badge-tag.md): A small pill that labels an object with a status (**Badge**) or a category (**Tag**). It's the same primitive; Badge shows a status dot by default. Source: [badge-tag.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/badge-tag.tsx.txt)
- [Banner](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/banner.md) **[deprecated]**: Do not use in new code; see the migration note. A full-width strip at the top of the app for product-wide announcements, promotions or warnings. Source: [banner.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/banner.tsx.txt)
- [Button](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/button.md): Buttons trigger an action on the current page: submitting a form, opening a modal, starting a scan. Source: [button.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/button.tsx.txt)
- [Checkbox](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/checkbox.md) **[beta]**: Lets the user turn an independent option on or off, or pick several items from a list. Source: [checkbox.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/checkbox.tsx.txt)
- [CVE Tag](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/cve-tag.md) **[beta]**: A CVE identifier that links to its advisory, with optional exploit signals: KEV (in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog) and EPSS (probability of exploitation in the next 30 days). Source: [cve-tag.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/cve-tag.tsx.txt)
- [CVSS Score](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/cvss-score.md) **[beta]**: A CVSS base score with its qualitative rating and, when given the vector string, each metric in plain words. Source: [cvss-score.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/cvss-score.tsx.txt)
- [Finding Status](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/finding-status.md) **[beta]**: Shows where a finding is in its lifecycle, from Open to Resolved, with an icon and a label for each status. Source: [finding-status.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/finding-status.tsx.txt)
- [Indicator](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/indicator.md) **[beta]**: An indicator of compromise (IP, domain, URL, hash, email) with type, reputation verdict and copy. Optional defanging (example[.]com). Source: [indicator.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/indicator.tsx.txt)
- [Masked Value](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/masked-value.md) **[beta]**: A secret — API key, token, password — shown masked, with reveal and copy. Source: [masked-value.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/masked-value.tsx.txt)
- [Scan Progress](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/scan-progress.md) **[beta]**: The stages of a scan or long job and where it is now: done, running, failed or pending. Source: [scan-progress.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/scan-progress.tsx.txt)
- [Select](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/select.md) **[beta]**: A single-choice dropdown that picks one value from a list of options. Source: [select.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/select.tsx.txt)
- [Severity Badge](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/severity-badge.md) **[beta]**: The canonical way to show a finding's severity (Critical → Info), optionally with its numeric score (e.g. CVSS). Source: [severity-badge.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/severity-badge.tsx.txt)
- [Severity Bar](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/severity-bar.md) **[beta]**: One horizontal bar that splits a set of findings by severity, with an optional legend of counts. Source: [severity-bar.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/severity-bar.tsx.txt)
- [Skeleton](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/skeleton.md): A pulsing placeholder that mirrors the shape of content while it loads. Source: [skeleton.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/skeleton.tsx.txt)
- [Spinner](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/spinner.md) **[beta]**: An indeterminate loading indicator for short waits when the shape of the result is unknown. Source: [spinner.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/spinner.tsx.txt)
- [Switch · Radio](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/switch-radio.md) **[beta]**: **Switch** turns a single setting on or off, effective immediately. **Radio** picks exactly one option from a small, visible set. Source: [switch-radio.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/switch-radio.tsx.txt)
- [Text Field](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/text-field.md) **[beta]**: A single-line input for short free text: names, domains, IPs, emails. Source: [text-field.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/text-field.tsx.txt)
- [Textarea](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/textarea.md) **[beta]**: A multi-line plain-text input for notes, descriptions and justifications. Source: [textarea.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/textarea.tsx.txt)
- [Toast · Tooltip](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/toast-tooltip.md): **Toast** is a brief, non-blocking confirmation of something that just happened. **Tooltip** is a short label or hint that appears on hover or focus of a control. Source: [toast-tooltip.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/toast-tooltip.tsx.txt)

## Molecules

- [Breadcrumb](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/breadcrumb.md): Shows where the current page sits in the hierarchy and lets users jump back up. Source: [breadcrumb.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/breadcrumb.tsx.txt)
- [Drawer](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/drawer.md) **[beta]**: A panel that slides in from the left or right edge for details or a short form, built like Modal. Source: [drawer.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/drawer.tsx.txt)
- [Dropdown menu](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/dropdown-menu.md) **[beta]**: A dropdown list of actions behind a button, following the WAI-ARIA menu-button pattern. Source: [dropdown-menu.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/dropdown-menu.tsx.txt)
- [Filter Bar](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/filter-bar.md) **[beta]**: A horizontal toolbar that combines search, filter pills and view actions above a table or list. Source: [filter-bar.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/filter-bar.tsx.txt)
- [Pagination](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/pagination.md) **[beta]**: Moves between pages of a long list; always shows the first, last and current pages with their neighbours. Source: [pagination.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/pagination.tsx.txt)
- [Search Bar](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/search-bar.md) **[beta]**: A text input dedicated to searching or filtering content, with a search icon and a clear button. Source: [search-bar.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/search-bar.tsx.txt)
- [Tabs](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/tabs.md): Switches between related views of the same object without leaving the page. Source: [tabs.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/tabs.tsx.txt)

## Organisms

- [Cards](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/cards.md): The container for dashboard content. `Card` and its parts are the base; `StatCard` is a ready-made preset for one number. Summaries and alerts are composed from the parts (see the styleguide page), not separate components. Source: [cards.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/cards.tsx.txt)
- [Chart](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/chart.md) **[beta]**: A dependency-free set of SVG chart primitives in a shared card shell: donut, bar, line and treemap, plus stat blocks. Source: [chart.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/chart.tsx.txt)
- [Command palette](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/command-palette.md) **[beta]**: A searchable list of commands and destinations opened with a shortcut; built on Modal. Source: [command-palette.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/command-palette.tsx.txt)
- [Data Table](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/data-table.md) **[beta]**: A composable card that lists findings (threat, asset, date, severity) with a header, column headers, rows and a pagination footer. Source: [data-table.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/data-table.tsx.txt)
- [Empty State](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/empty-state.md) **[beta]**: Fills a region that has no content yet. It explains why it's empty and what to do next. Source: [empty-state.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/empty-state.tsx.txt)
- [Gauge](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/gauge.md) **[beta]**: A semicircular meter that shows a single value against a known maximum, such as a security score. Source: [gauge.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/gauge.tsx.txt)
- [Modal](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/modal.md): A dialog that interrupts the current task to request a decision or focused input. It traps focus and blocks interaction with the rest of the page until it closes. Source: [modal.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/modal.tsx.txt)
- [Text Space](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/docs/components/text-space.md) **[alpha]**: A rich-text composer (toolbar + writing area) for formatted notes, reports and comments. Source: [text-space.tsx](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/components/text-space.tsx.txt)

## Optional

- [sentinel-manifest.json](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/sentinel-manifest.json): machine-readable component manifest — props with types and defaults, status, when to use, tokens, install command
- [llms-full.txt](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): every doc, the full theme CSS and every component's source in one file (~92k tokens)
- [Per-platform token exports](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/tokens/_all/tokens.css): CSS (light only), also [Swift](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/tokens/_all/tokens.swift) and [Android XML](https://ladan-design-system.vercel.app/tokens/_all/tokens.xml)
